title: Mario Kart: Super Circuit
shortDescription: A handheld kart racer that carries Mario Kart's item-driven competition into a compact Game Boy Advance format.
highlights: Readable racing courses designed around quick handheld sessions
Item-based competition that rewards route choice and timing

signals.rationale: A high-confidence Game Boy Advance starting point: its compact racing courses and item timing show how a console multiplayer formula was adapted for handheld play.
